test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Mohini starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards south. She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 7 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 3 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Mohini starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards south. She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 7 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 3 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70167faaa6d6738e6721a401fc7a1c9b635b8919b618e55339b526e8258e557c.png] 

Thus, Mohini should drive 4 km towards east to reach point A from point P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
